__comments: Counters are selected as {__name__=~"name(_total)?"}: the collector exposes bare counter names, and Grafana Cloud's OTLP ingestion appends _total. One selector works in both.

otelcol_* and hive_auth_* are emitted only by the customer-facing collector (the internal observability collector is not scraped), so they carry no pod matcher; that also keeps the dashboard working on a local Prometheus, which has no pod label. http_server_* is a generic name, so it is pinned to the customer port 4318.
Every exporter query filters exporter="clickhouse": the collector config also has a local-development otlp_grpc/tempo exporter, and its failures would pollute any unfiltered aggregate.

send_failed, enqueue_failed and the otlp/internal receiver series exist only after their first event, so rate() and increase() miss the first occurrence. Range stats add the first value of any series born inside the range, and the drop panel plots raw counters.

Known gap (needs a new metric): whether rows reached otel_traces. The exporter uses wait_for_async_insert=0, so acknowledged means buffered by ClickHouse, not stored; a failed flush is invisible and Grafana has no datasource for Hive's ClickHouse.
Known gap (needs a new metric): per-target volume and success. No metric carries a target id, so one target losing everything is invisible in the aggregates.
Known gap (needs a new metric): why a request got 401. Cached auth decisions and missing headers have no metric and no log line, and Envoy 401 access logs are not shipped to Loki.

Known gap (needs a new metric): loss on pod death. The batch buffer, the sending queue (on pod-local disk) and the last unscraped interval have no counter, and there is no restart or OOM metric. Visible only as a positive Unaccounted spans.
Known gap (needs a new metric): duplicates. A retry after a 5 s insert timeout that had in fact succeeded stores the batch twice.

panels.description: Collector pods whose metrics arrived recently, and the uptime of the youngest one. 0 means the collector is down or not scraped: every other panel is then empty because data is missing, not because ingestion is healthy.
panels.title: Collectors reporting

panels.description: Spans the collector accepted on all receivers, per second. Counted after authentication and decoding, so rejected requests are not in it.
panels.title: Spans accepted per second

panels.description: Share of requests on the customer port (4318) that the collector answered with an error, over the range. 5xx is on the Hive side (503 is the memory limiter, and Envoy retries each one twice). 401 is either bad customer credentials or the auth service failing; compare with the auth panels.

targets.expr: ((sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(min_over_time(http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__range]) unless http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?", http_response_status_code=~"5.."} offset $__range) or vector(0))) / clamp_min((sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(min_over_time(http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?"}[$__range]) unless http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?"} offset $__range) or vector(0)), 1)

((sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?", http_response_status_code="401"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(min_over_time(http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?", http_response_status_code="401"}[$__range]) unless http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?", http_response_status_code="401"} offset $__range) or vector(0))) / clamp_min((sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(min_over_time(http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?"}[$__range]) unless http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?"} offset $__range) or vector(0)), 1)

((sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?", http_response_status_code=~"4..", http_response_status_code!="401"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(min_over_time(http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?", http_response_status_code=~"4..", http_response_status_code!="401"}[$__range]) unless http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?", http_response_status_code=~"4..", http_response_status_code!="401"} offset $__range) or vector(0))) / clamp_min((sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(min_over_time(http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?"}[$__range]) unless http_server_request_duration_count{server_port="4318", pod=~"(otel-collector-.*)?"} offset $__range) or vector(0)), 1)

panels.title: Rejected requests (range)

panels.description: Fill of the fullest pod's ClickHouse sending queue (5000 batches). Healthy is about 0%. It grows when ClickHouse is slow or unreachable, and at 100% every new batch is dropped.
panels.title: ClickHouse queue fill

panels.description: Spans ClickHouse acknowledged divided by spans accepted, over the range. Judge it on an hour or more: a backlog lowers it and a draining backlog pushes it above 100%. Acknowledged means ClickHouse buffered the async insert, not that the rows are stored.
panels.title: Delivered to ClickHouse (range)

panels.description: Spans the sender got a success response for and the collector then dropped before ClickHouse: retries exhausted or a permanent error (export failed), or the sending queue was at capacity (queue full). Any non-zero value is customer data loss.

targets.expr: (sum(increase({__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans(_total)?", exporter="clickhouse"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(min_over_time({__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans(_total)?", exporter="clickhouse"}[$__range]) unless {__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans(_total)?", exporter="clickhouse"} offset $__range) or vector(0))

(sum(increase({__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_spans(_total)?", exporter="clickhouse"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(min_over_time({__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_spans(_total)?", exporter="clickhouse"}[$__range]) unless {__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_spans(_total)?", exporter="clickhouse"} offset $__range) or vector(0))

panels.title: Spans dropped after acceptance (range)

panels.description: Accepted spans that are neither acknowledged nor counted as dropped, as a share of accepted. Positive while the queue is empty means spans vanished without a counter (a pod replaced with a non-empty queue, a crash). Negative means an older backlog was delivered inside the range.

targets.expr: (sum(increase({__name__=~"otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans(_total)?"}[$__range])) - (sum(increase({__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_sent_spans(_total)?", exporter="clickhouse"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) - ((sum(increase({__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans(_total)?", exporter="clickhouse"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(min_over_time({__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans(_total)?", exporter="clickhouse"}[$__range]) unless {__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans(_total)?", exporter="clickhouse"} offset $__range) or vector(0))) - ((sum(increase({__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_spans(_total)?", exporter="clickhouse"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(min_over_time({__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_spans(_total)?", exporter="clickhouse"}[$__range]) unless {__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_spans(_total)?", exporter="clickhouse"} offset $__range) or vector(0)))) / clamp_min(sum(increase({__name__=~"otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans(_total)?"}[$__range])), 1)

panels.title: Unaccounted spans (range)

panels.description: Spans accepted on the unauthenticated internal receiver (ports 4319/4320). They are stored without hive.target_id, so no target can read them. Expected only in local development.

targets.expr: (sum(increase({__name__=~"otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans(_total)?", receiver="otlp/internal"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(min_over_time({__name__=~"otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans(_total)?", receiver="otlp/internal"}[$__range]) unless {__name__=~"otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans(_total)?", receiver="otlp/internal"} offset $__range) or vector(0))

panels.title: Unattributed spans (range)

panels.description: Requests on the customer port (4318) by response status. The only series that sees 401s and undecodable payloads (400), which never reach the span counters. A 401 rise together with a 200 drop is an auth outage, not bad tokens.
panels.title: Requests per second by status code

panels.description: Collector-side duration of accepted (200) requests. It includes the auth lookup on a cache miss and not the ClickHouse write, which happens after the response. A rising p99 with flat auth latency points at CPU or memory pressure.
panels.title: Request duration (accepted requests)

panels.description: Calls from the collector to the API's /otel-auth endpoint. Only cache misses are counted (a success is cached 30 s, a failure 10 s), so this is neither request volume nor an error percentage. error mixes rejected credentials with auth-service failures; the log row separates them.
panels.title: Auth lookups per second (cache misses only)

panels.description: Duration of the auth lookup; a cache miss blocks the sender's request for this long. A slow error p95 means the API is failing and being retried rather than rejecting credentials. Buckets top out at 10 s.
panels.title: Auth lookup duration

panels.description: Accepted and acknowledged should overlap. Acknowledged below accepted is a growing backlog, above is a backlog draining. Refused spans (the memory limiter) and spans that failed in the receiver were answered with an error, so the sender decides whether they are retried.
panels.title: Spans per second by stage

panels.description: Accepted minus acknowledged minus dropped, from the raw counters of one scrape: the spans sitting in the batch buffer, the queue and the in-flight insert. It should return to about 0. A value that stays high while the queue panel reads 0 is silent loss.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) ({__name__=~"otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans(_total)?"}) - (sum by (pod) ({__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_sent_spans(_total)?", exporter="clickhouse"}) or sum by (pod) ({__name__=~"otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans(_total)?"}) * 0) - (sum by (pod) ({__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans(_total)?", exporter="clickhouse"}) or sum by (pod) ({__name__=~"otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans(_total)?"}) * 0) - (sum by (pod) ({__name__=~"otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_spans(_total)?", exporter="clickhouse"}) or sum by (pod) ({__name__=~"otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans(_total)?"}) * 0)

panels.title: Spans inside the collector

panels.description: Batches waiting in the ClickHouse sending queue and the insert in flight, against the capacity. A single consumer retries one batch for up to 300 s while the rest wait, so a ClickHouse problem shows here minutes before any failure counter moves. The queue is on pod-local disk: what is queued when a pod is replaced is lost.
panels.title: ClickHouse sending queue (batches)

panels.description: Raw counters, not rates, because these series only exist after the first drop. Any step up is lost customer data. permanent=true means ClickHouse rejected a whole batch (up to 5000 spans across targets); queue full means the sending queue was at capacity.
panels.title: Dropped spans since pod start

panels.description: Non-200 responses Envoy returned for the trace ingestion route, by status. 200 and 401 access logs are not shipped to Loki, so this is neither volume nor auth failures. 502, 503 and 504 are requests the collector did not answer successfully after Envoy's retries.
panels.title: Envoy non-200 responses on the trace route

panels.description: Splits what the auth metric lumps together: 'authentication failed' with a 4xx status is a rejected credential or target, the other two messages are the auth service failing. Logged on cache misses only.

targets.expr: sum by (msg, status) (count_over_time({container_name="otel-collector"} | json | msg =~ `authentication failed|error calling authentication service|received 5xx response, retrying` [$__interval]))

panels.title: Collector auth events

panels.description: Collector warnings and errors by message, without the otlp_grpc/tempo exporter (see Process health). 'Exporting failed' and memory limiter messages here are on the customer data path.
panels.title: Collector warnings and errors by message

panels.description: The log lines behind the panel above.
panels.title: Collector warning and error lines

panels.description: Uptime resets are in-place container restarts such as OOM kills. A rollout or a scale-down shows only as more pods seen. Either way that pod's batch buffer and on-disk queue are gone.
panels.title: Restarts and pods (range)

panels.description: CPU cores used per pod. The autoscaler scales the collector on CPU only.
panels.title: CPU

panels.description: Above 800 MiB the memory limiter answers 503. The limiter's hard limit equals the production pod memory limit (1000 MiB), so an OOM kill can come first. The two reference lines are constants copied from the collector config.
panels.title: Memory

panels.description: The local-development Tempo exporter that is also in the collector config production runs, where it has no reachable endpoint. It is not the customer data path and is excluded from every other panel. Shown because its failures are expected noise, and because its in-memory queue uses memory the memory limiter counts.
panels.title: otlp_grpc/tempo exporter (not the customer data path)
